description: This file defines the PHP client class 'CodeStarNotificationsClient' for interacting with the AWS CodeStar Notifications service, including method annotations for various API operations and their async counterparts.

classes.name: CodeStarNotificationsClient
classes.description: A PHP client class to interact with AWS CodeStar Notifications service, extending the generic 'AwsClient' class.

methods.name: createNotificationRule
methods.description: Creates a new notification rule in AWS CodeStar Notifications.

methods.name: createNotificationRuleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new notification rule.

methods.name: deleteNotificationRule
methods.description: Deletes an existing notification rule by its identifier.

methods.name: deleteNotificationRuleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a notification rule.

methods.name: deleteTarget
methods.description: Removes a specified target from a notification rule.

methods.name: deleteTargetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes a target from a notification rule.

methods.name: describeNotificationRule
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific notification rule.

methods.name: describeNotificationRuleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a notification rule.

methods.name: listEventTypes
methods.description: Lists event types available for notification rules.

methods.name: listEventTypesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists event types.

methods.name: listNotificationRules
methods.description: Lists all notification rules.

methods.name: listNotificationRulesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists notification rules.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves tags for a resource.

methods.name: listTargets
methods.description: Lists targets associated with notification rules.

methods.name: listTargetsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists targets.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes a target to a notification rule.

methods.name: subscribeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously subscribes a target.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously tags a resource.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscription from a notification rule.

methods.name: unsubscribeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously unsubscribes.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags.

methods.name: updateNotificationRule
methods.description: Updates details of a notification rule.

methods.name: updateNotificationRuleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a notification rule.
